title: Тургояк (посёлок)
interpretation: Article identifies the settlement as a place in Chelyabinsk Oblast within Miass urban okrug, says it was urban-type through 2004, and explicitly reports 2010 population 2,618, matching the official selected 2010 row. The official selected 2002 row independently reports 2,292. The article supports temporal/place continuity but not coordinates. Existing accepted GeoKLADR 2011 point remains the point evidence; raw 2021 DaData coordinates differ by 12.58 km and are not substituted.
